source: Mt. Brighton trail map 2025-26 (VistaMap; skimap.org map 46038), read by hand

left_untraced.Chicken Chute: blue run with terrain-park features on the 2025-26 map; not in OpenStreetMap and not traced

lifts_note: The map numbers its lifts: chairs 1 to 5 (quad and triple chairs), rope tows and carpets 6 to 13; OpenStreetMap names most of them only 'Lift' or 'Surface lift', so they cannot be matched by name. Five chairs drawn on the map; five chairlifts on our map.
